mapper.select: SELECT password_hash AS passwordHash, email, student_no AS studentNo FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET is_deleted = 1, name = '탈퇴한 회원', login_id = CONCAT('deleted_', user_id), email = CONCAT('deleted_', user_id, '@removed.local'), phone = NULL, major = 'NONE', student_no = #{studentNoHash}, password_hash = CONCAT('withdrawn:', UUID()), social_id = NULL, last_login_at = NULL WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT ban_status AS banStatus, banned_until AS bannedUntil FROM users WHERE student_no = #{studentNoHash} AND is_deleted = 1
